notes: The bare aharei standing before ka-asher is unrepresented: the ASV writes one temporal expression, *as soon as*, and that compound is ka-asher's own rendering under rule 30, headed on the opening morpheme by rule 23.

derekh keeps an English noun of its own (*the way*), so rule 19's first sentence stands and the relational *to* goes to the rectum; the ASV writes a *the* before each of construct and rectum, so nothing is fronted (rule 29).
